author: LeCobalt
body:
Hello! I haven't been active on the community in a very long time. I started this map around a year ago when I wanted to make a huge map for Avicus. That project was left inactive for a long time. I got back to it around a month ago. It was just too big so I cropped a smaller portion of the world-painted world and found nice little river :3.

      I went ham with decorations but still, I think it'll have fun gameplay. Why? Because you'll get to blow the map OUT. Everything above water and inside the borders is destroyable. Players spawn in with tnt bows:D.

Builder:
  • LeCobalt
YML Master:
  • Zintenka :3
Overview :3



Image Album: http://imgur.com/a/u1P5v
Map Download: [Private] Add me on skype: "c0balt838" and ask me for download.
Map YML: [Private] Add me on skype: "c0balt838" and ask me for download.

If you have suggestions, questions or opinions, express yourself below:D

replies.author: LeCobalt
replies.body:
I do realize I'm bumping this year old thread. 


I do so asking for denial/approval from map developers. I originally thought it had gotten ignored because of me not putting the download links directly, but since others have not done so, and since I originally did it as to protect the distribution of the map, I think that wasn't the problem.

I've revised the yml, and I think it should still work even though it's a 1.8 map, if it ends up not working, if it gets tested, I'd be glad to help by fixing it.

replies.author: Crimson_Aught
replies.body:
Now you need an XML instead of YML, since Avicus was updated. You can find examples here (https://maps.avicus.net) in atlas directory. 
Or ask someone to make it for you.

IMO, this map deserve a reply from map devs! Good work.
